usage.finalMessage:
The new `move <appointment> <date> <time>` command works and is committed with the report; all 6 tests pass (`dotnet test Clinic.slnx`). It uses the same date-range and one-per-time-slot checks as booking, is listed in `help` and the README directly after `cancel`, and I added a test confirming a refused move changes nothing.
One existing rule has no decision record: clinician `k2` (Dr. Patel, walk-in list) never counts as booked, so `k2` appointments can also be moved onto taken times. I left it unchanged and recorded it as an open question in `.work/report.json`. Two smaller open questions are also there: moving an appointment to its own current time is refused, and appointments in the past can be moved.
OUTCOME: completed
